title: Leads
description: Enquiries from your ads, WhatsApp and the front desk, assigned as they arrive.

filtered.title: No leads match these filters
filtered.description: Try another source or assignee, or search for part of a name or phone number.

new.title: No new leads waiting
new.description: Enquiries from Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and WhatsApp land here the moment they arrive, already assigned.

open.title: No open leads
open.description: Leads you have contacted or qualified stay here until they become deals.

converted.title: No converted leads yet
converted.description: When a lead turns into a deal, it moves here with a link to the deal.

disqualified.title: Nothing disqualified
disqualified.description: Spam, wrong numbers and people who aren't interested end up here.

all.title: No leads yet
all.description: Connect your ad accounts in Settings, or add a walk-in or phone enquiry by hand.

add.title: Add a lead
add.description: For walk-ins, phone calls and referrals. It is assigned and gets a 15-minute reply task like any other lead.
add.name: Name
add.messagePlaceholder: e.g. Asked about Invisalign prices and weekend appointments
add.mergedDescription: We added this enquiry to their timeline instead of creating a duplicate.

errors.name: Enter the person's name.
errors.reach: Add a mobile number or an email so the team can reach them.

disqualify.title: Disqualify {{name}}
disqualify.description: The lead leaves your open list and its reply tasks are cancelled. The history stays on the timeline.
disqualify.reason: Why are you disqualifying this lead?
disqualify.reasonRequired: Choose a reason so the team knows why this lead was closed.

convert.title: Convert {{name}} to a deal
convert.description: Creates the contact and the deal in one step. The WhatsApp chat and open tasks move with them.
convert.useExisting: Link to the existing contact instead

errors.contact: Choose the existing contact to link this lead to.
errors.companyName: Enter the company name, or set Company to None.
errors.company: Choose the company, or set Company to None.
errors.title: Give the deal a title.
errors.value: Enter the deal value in AED, e.g. 18500.

detail.noMessage: No message came with this lead, only the form answers below.
detail.returningHint: This person is already in your contacts. Converting links the new deal to them.
detail.converted: Converted. The deal and contact carry this lead's history.
